notes: The source minecraft-data repository is not itself an npm package; it is injected into a pinned node-minecraft-data checkout before data.js generation.
Local file dependencies are used so npm resolves the experimental components as one coherent stack rather than silently falling back to released packages.
Additional 26.3 Mineflayer PRs are intentionally excluded from the first placement rep unless the bounded placement test demonstrates they are required.
The Mineflayer 26.3 admission patch is local harness provenance, not an upstream support claim; all runtime behavior remains subject to the physical-placement oracle.
Prismarine Physics PR #145 is included because the preceding live rep reached Mineflayer injection and failed exactly on the missing 26.3 proportionalLiquidGravity table entry.

harness_patches.purpose: Extend Mineflayer's testedVersions admission guard to 26.3 only after the pinned experimental minecraft-data layer resolves protocol 777.
Integrate the upstream 26.3 client tick-end semantics into the pinned teleport-confirm branch after the live rep reached spawn and was kicked before placement.
